title: Every site amplify.yml is deploy-only (TI and Papyrus-web drop npm test; all regenerate from build-specs)
description:
Repos and files: AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence `amplify.yml` (remove `npm test` from frontend build), AnthusAI/Papyrus-web `amplify.yml` (remove `PAPYRUS_WEB_PYTHON=... npm test`), AnthusAI/Anth.us-web, Shipped-web, Distinctive-web, Pilobol.us, p.apyr.us, DataParade-newsroom `amplify.yml` (confirm already deploy-only; regenerate from the app shell so they match `build-specs.ts` exactly: `npx papyrus-infra ...` build-spec print command if present, otherwise copy the generated spec).

Steps per repo: bump `papyrus-newsroom`/`@anthusai/papyrus` to the version that carries the deploy-only `withPapyrus()`; edit amplify.yml; keep `cache.paths` (`.next/cache/**/*`, `.npm/**/*`); open a PR; the repo's CI (Actions, or local + receipt for private repos) is the gate; merge = deploy. For Papyrus-web and DataParade-newsroom merge only after the receipt gate stories, or with Ryan's explicit OK since those repos have no gate today.

Acceptance: `grep -E "test|lint|tsc|typecheck" amplify.yml` is empty in every repo; the next main build's log shows no check step and finishes faster (record before/after minutes in a comment on this story); no deploy regressions (site loads, /newsroom signs in).
Gherkin: add to each repo's features a scenario "Amplify build is deploy-only" asserting the amplify.yml command list (a tiny spec-reading test).
